attachments.name: 24-0519 Service Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement 2023-2024 – Office of the Superintendent

enrichment.headline: Pays Care Solace up to $102,291 to connect students and families with mental health care
enrichment.summary: The district is paying Care Solace, Inc. for a web-based service that helps staff, students and family contacts find and connect with mental health treatment providers, including a "Warm Hand-off" process. A separate data sharing agreement (DSA) covers the student information shared with the vendor. Both run from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024, and the work began before the Board's vote.
